title: La familia de Emma
setting: Emma te cuenta cosas de su familia y tú le haces preguntas.

says.t: Guess what? My mum has a new job!
says.es: ¿A que no sabes? ¡Mi madre tiene trabajo nuevo!

options.feedback: Solo una -s por frase: What does she do?
En la pregunta hace falta does delante: What does she do?

says.t: She works in a bookshop. She loves books!
says.es: Trabaja en una librería. ¡Le encantan los libros!

options.t: How nice! Does she work every day?
How nice! Do she work every day?
options.feedback: Con she el ayudante es does: Does she work…?

says.t: No, she doesn't. Only three days a week.
says.es: No. Solo tres días a la semana.

options.t: Perfect. And your dad? Is he retired?
Perfect. And your dad? Does he retired?
options.feedback: Retired es un adjetivo: va con to be. Is he retired?

says.t: Yes, he is. He plays golf and he watches a lot of TV.
says.es: Sí. Juega al golf y ve mucho la tele.

options.t: Ha ha! Does he help at home?
Ha ha! Does he helps at home?

says.t: Yes! He cooks dinner and he does the shopping.
says.es: ¡Sí! Hace la cena y hace la compra.

options.t: Wow, he cooks! Your mum is lucky.
Wow, he cook! Your mum is lucky.
Wow, he cooks! Your mum has lucky.
options.feedback: Tener suerte = be lucky: your mum is lucky.

says.t: She is! What about you? Does anyone cook for you?
says.es: ¡Sí que la tiene! ¿Y tú? ¿Alguien cocina para ti?

options.t: No, I cook. But my grandson makes great sandwiches!
options.es: No, cocino yo. ¡Pero mi nieto hace unos bocadillos buenísimos!
